content:
Maria Hernandez: spotted a tenant showing negative per-call cost in console after prefetch warmup. screenshot: https://img.redwood.internal/warmup-odd.png
Dave Kim: can you share an example econ row? sounds like double crediting.
Maria Hernandez: sample row from staging: `{invocation_id: inv-2026-03-23-090, tenant_id: acme-inc, tokens_total: 500, tokens_cached: 460, cache_credits_assigned: 12, prefetch_amort_window: 1000}`
Joanne Patel: yep this is probably UI applying sampled_prefetch_credit on top of cache_credits_assigned emitted by ingest.
Dave Kim: two fixes: add canonical ingest field so UI skips sampling, or change UI to detect and skip when cache_credits_assigned present.
Maria Hernandez: prefer ingest emit a canonical signal so support and logs match.
Joanne Patel: propose telemetry fields: `prefetch_credit_origin` ("ingest"|"ui"|"router") and `prefetch_credit_bucket`. UI rule: if origin=="ingest" skip client sampling.
Dave Kim: I'll build a small readonly endpoint `/econ/preview?tenant=...&prefetch_id=...` that returns the first 50 amortized steps, cached server-side. UI will show a "show amortization" hover link to fetch it.
Maria Hernandez: nice. action items: Joanne add telemetry fields + feature flag `econ_ui_sampling_v2=false`. Dave add preview endpoint + cache. Maria write a support blurb. target: patch to staging in 48h.
ops-bot: deploy queued: econometrics-ingest v3.4 -> staging at 1789901300 by @joanne :rocket:
Joanne Patel: will post PR and migration notes when ready.
Dave Kim: will add lightweight tests to detect negative unit cost regressions.
Maria Hernandez: thanks — should cut down noisy support screenshots. cc @product.
